lab.feedDescription: Technical articles for Sony Alpha shooters, filtered by topic and skill level.
lab.pinnedTitle: Thiết lập Sony Alpha trong 8 bước
lab.pinnedDek: Tám cài đặt cần đổi trước buổi chụp đầu tiên, kèm đường dẫn menu cho cả hai đời máy và một bảng tổng để tra lại.
lab.emptyBody: Không có bài viết nào thuộc chủ đề và trình độ bạn đang chọn. Bỏ bớt một bộ lọc để xem thêm.
lab.firmwareDisclaimer: Tên mục menu có thể khác đôi chút giữa các bản firmware và giữa các dòng máy. Nếu không thấy đúng tên, tìm mục gần nhất trong cùng nhóm — giá trị cần đặt vẫn như trên.
lab.setupSubline: 8 bước · trước buổi chụp đầu tiên
lab.setupTitle: Tám cài đặt cần đổi trước khi chụp
lab.setupLede: Mặc định của máy được đặt cho mọi người, không cho bạn. Tám mục dưới đây là những mục thay đổi kết quả rõ nhất — làm một lần rồi thôi.
lab.recapTitle: Tất cả cài đặt trong một bảng
lab.recapNoteOld: Đường dẫn dưới đây theo menu cũ (a6400 · ZV-E10). Đổi công tắc ở đầu trang nếu máy bạn dùng menu mới.
lab.recapNoteNew: Đường dẫn dưới đây theo menu mới (a6700 · ZV-E10 II). Đổi công tắc ở đầu trang nếu máy bạn dùng menu cũ.

labAdmin.notAdminBody: This screen is for Alpha Tech Blogs editors. Sign in with an editor address, or ask an administrator to add yours.
labAdmin.pickTitle: Pick an article, or start a new one
labAdmin.pickBody: Every article is a list of typed blocks — a paragraph, a menu pair, a table, a comparison. There is no free-form body, which is what keeps the contents rail, the checklists and the comparison labels working.
labAdmin.savedWithDropped: Saved. {n} block(s) were incomplete and were not stored.
labAdmin.discardConfirm: You have unsaved changes. Discard them?
labAdmin.deleteConfirm: Delete “{title}” permanently? Uploaded images stay in storage.
labAdmin.specRemaining: {n} rule(s) left before this can be published
labAdmin.title: Title
labAdmin.slugOnCreate: The URL is generated from the title when you first save.
labAdmin.tldrHint: Exactly three, each a decision or an action
labAdmin.headingHint: A sentence with a verb, never a noun label
labAdmin.tableCaptionHint: State the conditions the table was measured under
labAdmin.calloutLabelHint: The condition it applies under, not the word “note”
labAdmin.compareNeedsBoth: The slider stays hidden until both images are set.
labAdmin.checklistItemsHint: Three to six, each verifiable by eye on the camera
labAdmin.figureCaptionHint: Add information; never re-describe the picture
labAdmin.figureAltHint: What a reader who cannot see it needs to know
labAdmin.embedUrlHint: YouTube or Vimeo. Paste the link and the id is taken from it.
labAdmin.embedUnrecognised: That link was not recognised as a YouTube or Vimeo video.
labAdmin.embedCaptionHint: What the reader should watch for

errors.notAdmin: Your account is not an editor.
errors.notConfigured: The article store is not configured on this deployment.
errors.badRequest: The article could not be read. Check the topic, level and archetype.
errors.titleRequired: An article needs a title before it can be created.
errors.saveFailed: Could not save. Nothing was changed.
errors.deleteFailed: Could not delete. Nothing was changed.
errors.uploadFailed: The image could not be uploaded.
errors.unsupportedType: Only JPEG, PNG, WebP and GIF are accepted.
errors.specViolation: Publishing was refused. The rules below are still unmet.
errors.tooFewBlocks: An article needs at least eight blocks.
errors.tooManyBlocks: Over sixteen blocks — this is two articles.
errors.mustOpenWithTldr: The first block must be the TL;DR.
errors.tldrNeedsContext: A paragraph of context must follow the TL;DR.
errors.headingTooEarly: The first heading must come after the TL;DR and its paragraph.
errors.mustCloseWithChecklistOrFigure: An article closes on a checklist or an image, never a paragraph.
errors.repeatedBlock: Two blocks of the same type sit next to each other. Only menu pairs may repeat.
errors.menuSeparator: A menu path separates its steps with an arrow and a space either side.
errors.tableRows: A table holds three to six rows.
errors.checklistItems: A checklist holds three to six items.
errors.compareLabels: A comparison is labelled with real parameters, not “before” and “after”.
errors.calloutLabel: A callout is labelled with its condition, not the word “note”.
errors.emoji: Remove the emoji. This is a reference product.
errors.exclamation: Remove the exclamation marks. They read as marketing copy.
errors.controlUnavailable: The sign-in service is not answering right now. Nothing was changed — try again shortly.

labAdmin.imageNone: No image yet. Upload one — JPEG, PNG or WebP, up to 8 MB.
labAdmin.imagePreviewExpired: Preview link expired. Reopen the article to see it again.
labAdmin.saveBeforeUpload: Save the article first — an image has to belong to it.
labAdmin.foreignAsset: One of the images belongs to another article. Nothing was published.
labAdmin.assetSyncFailed: The images could not be moved. The article was not changed as intended — reopen it to see its current state.
labAdmin.unsupportedType: That file is not a JPEG, PNG or WebP. Animated images are not supported.
labAdmin.dimensionsTooLarge: That image is too large in pixels. Resize it under 12000 on each side.
labAdmin.gateDownBody: The sign-in service is not answering right now. This is not a permissions problem — your access is unchanged. Try again shortly.
